The focus and care you put into blending foundation or perfecting eyeliner can feel like a meditative practice, giving you a few moments to yourself before the day’s demands take over.

If it makes you feel put-together and ready to face the world, then it’s absolutely worth the time. Everyone deserves a little ritual that helps them feel their best—however that looks for them.
